{{dablink|For other uses of the word "red," see [[Red]].}}
'''Red daisy''' is an [[herb]]. Almost nothing is known about it. It can, however, be combined in a tea with [[sheepstongue root]]. Both of those herbs taste horribly bitter. [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] once treatened [[Elayne Trakand]] with such a concoction.{{ref/book|5|13}}
